Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: AI-generated 2D character-design portrait for owner choice, not model evidence.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the approved male A03 Blender character. Do not edit or reproduce this male character. Match its degree of stylization: softly rounded planar 3D forms, simplified coherent nose/ear/eyelid anatomy, matte skin, restrained texture, warm-neutral studio light and gray background. Do not transfer its blocky brows or large round eye aperture.
Create ONE original woman: AVA MORGAN, ALTERNATIVE A. She clearly reads as an adult around 29, a warm approachable cafe worker in a modern American small town. Gentle oval facial silhouette with adult midface length and a supported softly rounded jaw/chin; softly almond-shaped moderately sized brown eyes, upper lids naturally overlapping upper iris; relaxed warm closed-mouth expression; lightly rounded natural nose; softly tapered fine, low-contrast brown eyebrows that look like fine hair rather than solid graphic strips; modest low-relief lips with subdued natural color, no lipstick/gloss; faint freckles. The identity should feel specific and human, with slight natural asymmetry, not a generic doll or a feminized copy of the male.
Medium/dark chestnut brunette hair, relaxed softly gathered LOW bun near the nape, blended root/gather transition, a few fine tapered face-framing wisps. Broad primary hair volumes with subtle directional strands, not thick tubular curls or a plastic helmet.
Composition: one square portrait, head and upper shoulders visible, three-quarter view about 25–30 degrees facing picture-left, eye-level, full bun and top of hair inside frame, ample gray margin. Ivory everyday top and olive cafe apron straps at the bottom edge. Match reference's visual simplicity and game-world rendering language; do not make this photographic, anime, beauty-fashion, or hyperreal.
No text, no label, no logo, no watermark, no other person, no turnaround sheet.
Avoid childlike proportions, huge forehead/tiny pointed chin, round wide-open eyes, sleepy half-closed eyes, thick graphic brows, plumped lips, heavy makeup, high-shine skin, coarse plastic hair locks, over-detailed realistic pores.

Use case: identity-preserve / character-design refinement.

Keep A's identity, soft oval facial silhouette, hair arrangement/low loose bun, fine tapered brows, freckles, cream top/olive apron, gray studio backdrop, pose, framing, colors and soft stylized 3D shading.
Make one focused correction to A's adult facial proportions: the current eye apertures and round irises read too large/young. Make both eyes distinctly horizontal SOFT ALMOND shapes; reduce vertical aperture about 20 percent with natural upper-lid overlap, moderately smaller iris/globe appearance while keeping her awake and welcoming. Remove pointed dark eyeliner wings; use a soft natural lash edge. Give the midface and lower-face support a modest adult length, a softly rounded substantial chin rather than a tiny pointed V, and slightly quieter lower-cheek fullness. Retain the lightly rounded nose and a warm relaxed closed-mouth expression. Lips remain modest low-projection, low-contrast and matte. She should unmistakably read as an adult late-20s/early-30s small-town woman rather than an animated teenage heroine. Achieve maturity through coherent proportions, not wrinkles, makeup, age spots or harsher realism.
Preserve A's gentle warmth and natural oval character so she remains clearly different from an elongated, sharp-cheekboned confident alternative. Match A03 through simplified coherent planes, matte materials and controlled detail, not through copying his large round eyes or graphic brows.
One portrait only, no text or extra views, no new props, no photorealism, no doll/beauty-ad face.
